title: QPACK RFC 9204 Foundation Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, QPACK milestone and instruction-stream tests, HTTP/3 QPACK error-matrix tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for the standalone RFC 9204 QPACK floor.
scope: This verification covers the standalone QPACK floor: prefixed integers, string literals, the static table, field-section encoding and decoding, dynamic-table accounting, blocked-stream synchronization, and incremental encoder/decoder instruction parsing. It does not verify HTTP/3 request/response semantics or runtime stream-state capture/restore behavior in the HTTP/3 layer.
preconditions: The repo remains in the JSON-only SpecTrace workflow.
The QPACK module stays standalone and does not depend on Incursa.Quic.
expected_result: The focused QPACK tests pass, the requirement-home tests confirm trace linkage for the standalone RFC 9204 floor, core SpecTrace JSON validation accepts the new artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The standalone QPACK implementation is trace-owned by canonical RFC 9204 artifacts and is covered by focused milestone, instruction-stream, and error-matrix tests. Runtime HTTP/3 stream-state capture and restore work remains a separate layer concern.
